data.gender_notes: Mitlesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is the friend of God. Derived from the Sanskrit words 'Mit' meaning friend and 'Lesh' meaning God. In Hindu mythology, Mitlesh is a name given to those who are close to the divine. The name Mitlesh carries the meaning “Friend of God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mitlesh usually hope their child will grow to embody friend of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mitlesh total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
